_comment: Mobi by Rogers. Carried from the sister project's column_eras.json, which mapped 34 distinct headers across 31 layouts over its full archive, and re-verified here by pipeline/census.py. Yes, 'Memebership type' and 'Return temperature (Â°C)' are real headers Mobi shipped. The richest of the three schemas: the only one with distance, per-trip temperature, and stopover behaviour.

_eras.2017: one ALL-of-2017 workbook; formats drift xlsx / csv / sheets across the archive
_eras.2018+: monthly; five distinct timestamp formats; per-trip temperatures degrade to 0-sentinels after mid-2025
_eras.note: The period label is NOT the content month - the file published as 2025-01 holds February rows. Canonical month is derived at conform.
